title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideos #GuessingGame #Dragons #Kidify #FunForKids #BrainTeaser

scenes.narration: One of these eggs hides a dragon — but which one?
We've got the red egg, the blue egg, and the golden egg. Pick your favorite!
Think you know? The countdown is on!
The red egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The blue egg hatches and… it's a tiny sneezing hamster! So close!
The GOLDEN egg glows, shakes, and… a baby dragon pops out! You found it!
Did you guess right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
